full_judgment: 4. Mr MM Shafiullah, learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the settlement officer and the appellate officer entrusted with the power under Chapters 15 and 17 of the SAT Act, 1950 and they were not entrusted with the power under section 151 to entertain any application. The power of settlement officer is limited within the Chapters 15 and 17, but the appellate officer exercised his power under section 151 under Chapter 18, as such, the order under challenge is without jurisdiction, void and of no legal effect. In support of his submissions he has referred to the memo dated 2-2-1995 and memo dated 3-9-2015 issued by the Land Ministry wherein, Ministry of Land once again reminded the settlement officer and appeal officer not to exercise their power under any other Chapter of the SAT Act except the power given under Chapters 15 and 17.
